# Multivision IPTV

> Multivision IPTV is an IPTV subscription service for viewers in the USA. It streams 50,000+ live TV channels and 200,000+ movies and series on demand, in up to 4K, to devices people already own — with no cable box and no contract.

## Key facts

- Service: IPTV (internet protocol television) subscription
- Market: United States (works worldwide)
- Live channels: 50,000+ (US entertainment, sports, news, kids, international)
- On demand: 200,000+ movies and series
- Quality: up to 4K Ultra HD
- Catch-up TV: 7 days on supported channels
- Simultaneous screens: 1 to 4
- Devices: Amazon Firestick / Fire TV, Android TV boxes, Smart TVs (Samsung, LG, Sony), iPhone and iPad, Android phones, Windows, macOS, MAG boxes
- Compatible apps: TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, GSE IPTV, Perfect Player and any M3U / Xtream Codes player
- Recommended internet speed: 10 Mbps for HD, 25 Mbps for 4K
- Free trial: 3 hours, no credit card
- Support: 24/7 via WhatsApp (+212 710-141872) and email (multivisonsupport@gmail.com)

## Pricing (USD, one device, one-time payment, no auto-renewal)

- 1 month: $19.99
- 3 months: $39.99 ($13.33/month)
- 6 months: $55.99 ($9.33/month)
- 12 months: $79.99 ($6.67/month)
- 24 months: $129.99 ($5.42/month)
